title: Assembly shift revision briefing
passage: Revision C changes the connector step. To assemble, attend the morning briefing and sign the record. If you miss the briefing, label sealed boxes until the next session. Keep a clear paper trail. On the training sheet, cross out any mistake with one line and initial the correction. The line leader files that same sheet. Don’t copy signatures to a new page. Yesterday’s shortage is over. Fresh stock is cleared for assembly. Yesterday’s opened trays stay on the hold rack until Quality signs their tags. Keep the line working, but use cleared stock only.
passageZh: C 版變更了連接器的安裝步驟。要開始組裝，必須先參加早上的說明會，再簽署紀錄。若錯過說明會，就先替已封箱的產品貼標，等下一場。要保留清楚、可追查的書面紀錄。訓練表上若寫錯，只用一條線劃掉錯誤，並在更正處簽上姓名縮寫；線長會把同一張表歸檔。不要把簽名抄到新表上。昨天的缺料已經解決，新補到的庫存已獲放行，可以用於組裝。昨天已拆封的料盤要留在待確認架上，等品管在標籤上簽核。產線要保持運作，但只能使用已獲放行的庫存。
